name: Breadcrumb
description: Navigation breadcrumb trail with links and current-page indicator
designIntent: Breadcrumb shows the user's location in a hierarchy and lets them navigate back to parent levels. The last item is the current page, marked with aria-current=page.

props.name: items
props.description: Ordered breadcrumb items; the last is the current page

examples.title: Three-level breadcrumb
examples.code:
<Breadcrumb items={[
  { label: 'Home', href: '/' },
  { label: 'Docs', href: '/docs' },
  { label: 'Components' },
]} />

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Breadcrumb for flat navigation
antiPatterns.explanation: Breadcrumb is for hierarchical structures. Use a nav menu or tabs for flat peer pages.

antiPatterns.title: Don't make the current page a link
antiPatterns.explanation: The last item should be plain text with aria-current=page, not a link to itself.

accessibility.implementation: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb] so screen readers announce the landmark
accessibility.userRequirements: Don't place multiple breadcrumbs on one page
Only one item should have aria-current

guidelines: Match the page title of each level
